title: Johnny Barrows, Mildred and how musicians spark each other
summary: How talent grows in small circles, such as Mildred, Bing and Bob Crosby.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: The great horn player, Johnny Barrows, used to tell me in Montana he would go to school, very much like Mildred Bailey riding to school on a horse, for ten or fifteen miles, and he would play the horn on horseback and probably why he became such a great horn player is because of that.
Here was a guy who lived all the way out in the boondocks, with no sort of enticement to do this, except a wish to do it. Where did it come from? Where did Mildred's come from?

Bob Crosby, Bing, Mildred's brother, they were all in the same group, going to school together. They sparked one another, and I know that's happened here in this area where one person sparked another, and I know that also from reading about it, this is what happened at a given point in
Europe with (inaudible), with people like that, all living in a university town and trading ideas.
It was kind of like a mini environment, I suppose.
